d: Unofficial PS Vita port of the iOS version of The Simpsons Arcade (EA Mobile).
ld: The port is a loader. It runs the game's own iOS ARM code natively on the Vita, with the iOS system parts (Objective-C runtime, Foundation, UIKit, CoreGraphics, OpenGL ES, OpenAL and AudioQueue) replaced by Vita code.
req:
- kubridge by bythos14
- libshacccg.suprx (Sony's shader compiler) in ur0:data/ or ur0:data/external/.
- About 130 MB free on ux0: (the .ipa is 51 MB, the game it unpacks 66 MB).
